summary: 3DNow!/MMX multi-quaternion composition: loads up to four input quaternions (a5..a8), performs shortest-path sign-flip selection by comparing packed sum-vs-difference squared lengths (pfcmpgt + packsswb), negates selected inputs via pxor 0x8000000080000000, normalizes the a6 quaternion and two product pairs through reciprocal refinements (pfrcp/pfrcpit1/pfrcpit2, pfrsqrt/pfrsqit1) guarded by >=1.0 and magnitude threshold checks, calls SquareRootApproximation, sub_529700 and PackedFloatingPointMath for the normalization paths, and writes three output quaternions (a2, a3, a4); a4 receives the selected a7 components directly and is also the return value.

operations.description: Load input quaternion components a5 (m64_u64, v109) and a6 (v110, v111) into temporaries.
Compute packed sum (v8,v9) and difference (v10,v11) of a5 and a6, then accumulate squared lengths (v13, v14) via pfadd/pfmul/pfacc.
Compute packed sum (v15,v16) and difference (v17,v18) of a6 and a7; form v19 = pfcmpgt comparing the two accumulated squared-length pairs (sum-vs-difference).
Convert v19 to integer v20 via packsswb + cvtsi64_si32; if bit 0 set, negate a5 components with pxor 0x8000000080000000 (shortest-path sign flip).
If bit 0x10000 set, negate a7 components (v112, v113) with pxor 0x8000000080000000.

Form sum (v22,v23) and difference (v24,v25) of selected a7 and a8, accumulate squared lengths (v26,v27), and compare to select a sign flip for a8 (v114,v115 negated when difference length exceeds sum length).
Normalize a6: squared length v28/v29, reciprocal via pfrcp + pfrcpit1 + pfrcpit2, negated masked components v116/v118 guarded by pfcmpgt 0x80000000800000.
Quaternion cross multiplication of selected a5 by normalized a6: build lane shuffles (v33,v34) and accumulate products v126/v130 via pfacc over pfsub/pfadd/pfmul terms.
Quaternion cross multiplication of selected a7 (v112,v113) by normalized a6 producing v134/v136.

Normalize first product pair: when high dword is below 1.0 (pfcmpge 0x3F8000003F800000 fails), call SquareRootApproximation(0, v12) then sub_529700(); if magnitude >= 0x3400000034000000 refine by reciprocal and scale v126/v130.
Combine normalized components with the -0.25 factor (0xBE800000BE800000) into v127/v131, then refine a length reciprocal via pfacc/pfrsqrt/pfrsqit1.
Call PackedFloatingPointMath() to set up packed components for the first output composition.
Guard on refined length (pfcmpge abs >= 0x3400000034000000) selecting the scale multiplier; assemble v124 from the packed multiplier pair.
Write output a2 (a2[0], a2[1]) via pfacc accumulation of the quaternion product of the selected a5 and a6 components.
Normalize selected a7 (v112,v113): squared length v65/v66, reciprocal refinement, masked negated v117/v119.
Quaternion products of normalized a6 with selected a7 (v128/v132) and with selected a8 (v135/v137).
Normalize the v128/v132 pair: when high dword is below 1.0, call SquareRootApproximation(0, v54) and sub_529700(); refine by reciprocal when magnitude >= 0x3400000034000000 and scale.
Normalize the v135/v137 pair identically: SquareRootApproximation(0, v54), sub_529700(), and optional reciprocal refinement.
Combine the second normalized pair with the -0.25 factor (0xBE800000BE800000) into v129/v133 and refine the reciprocal-sqrt length.
Call PackedFloatingPointMath() for the second output composition.
Scale the second product by the refined multiplier when the length passes the threshold; assemble v125.
Write output a3 (a3[0], a3[1]) from the a7/a8 product composition.
Write output a4 from the selected a7 components (v112, v113) and return a4.

Read ten packed qword globals (5AF918, 5AF928, 5AF938, 5AF940, 5AF948, 5AF950, 5AF970, 5AF988, 5AF9D0, 5B06E0) as 3DNow! constants/masks for sign flips, comparisons and normalization thresholds; their contents are not present in the packet.
